source_candidates.rights_scope_note: TVTMS reference-summary metadata is implemented with upstream attribution and changes recorded. TBESH/TBESG remain proposed pending exact file/header review. No amalgamated text or AI-authored description was imported.
source_candidates.pinned_component_scope: Selected TVTMS English-to-Hebrew-MT summary only; lexical components remain unselected.

source_candidates.rights_scope_note: Selected apparatus artifact only after notice verification; edition support is not manuscript attestation.
Select identified witness files, preserving MES damage/supplied/correction markers; separate the modern critical-text directory and downstream license decisions.
Terms reserve reproduction/display rights except single private-use copies. This plan permits citation/link research only; reproduction needs a separate decision.
Dataset terms are noncommercial. No reusable app corpus or training approval is granted here.

Edition and digital artifact remain unselected. CCAT commercial-use restrictions and other conditions prevent treating that distribution as a default reusable import. Identify Old Greek/Theodotion and deuterocanonical inventories separately.
Only individual works/editions/translations after checking TEI headers and notices; upstream warns headers are not all checked.

Oracc guidance gives default Attribution-ShareAlike with project exceptions; exact project, version, license and third-party components must be checked. Live page retrieval failed in this research; official indexed guidance was available.
Taylor Prism and Cyrus Cylinder are bibliographic/object leads. No image or modern-translation reproduction rights were assessed or granted.
Institutional authority for NT manuscript identifiers and its reconstruction work. No blanket metadata, transcription or image reuse license was established here.

artifact_provenance_required_before_impo: Stable manuscript/work/object and source IDs; edition, translator and physical hand where relevant.
Exact immutable repository commit or edition/release plus per-file SHA256, retrieval date, license-notice SHA256 and public locator.
Original representation and preservation/encoding status; normalized search text separately derived with transformation code version.
Separate source text, transcription, translation, annotation, image and authored-note rights decisions.
Record source-reference numbering and checked user-reference mapping; never align only by matching a verse number.
record_schema_status: Draft JSON Schema for future evidence records; no records have been asserted or imported.
semantic_validation_rules: Every citation, claim-alternative and source ID resolves within the record or approved source registry.
Every historical or textual assertion has a supporting locator or is explicitly labeled an inference/uncertain claim.
No manuscript attestation is derived solely from an edition-comparison apparatus.
Unpreserved/damaged/unchecked text is never converted to an omission.
BCE/CE dates have no year zero; ranges must be ordered and their evidence supplied; composition, narrative setting, witness and edition remain separate.
An approved record requires an author distinct from the relevant specialist reviewer, bound content hash and completed relevant use decisions.
App approval does not imply training approval. Training may only include components separately approved for that use and release plan.
All substantive disputed claims require a recorded alternative or an explicit statement that contrary evidence has not yet been assessed.
No unsupported consensus claims, invented sources, hidden synthetic ground truth or blanket corpus-license inference.

roles: Different qualified Hebrew/Aramaic or Greek textual reviewer
Relevant period specialist for historical inferences

review_workflow.ai_role: Draft assistance and mechanical checks; no claim of independent expert certification.
record_before_acceptance: Exact source and reviewed content hashes
Rights scope for every included component
review_workflow.completion_gate: All40 records meet mechanical and scholarly checks; blocked items keep explicit coverage records and any same-allocation replacement is versioned.

future_training_hypotheses.treatment: Supervise checked answers grounded in approved evidence packets: distinguish witness/edition, translate alternatives, cite support and handle missing evidence.
future_training_hypotheses.targets: Authored from approved source records; independently checked; multiple defensible renderings accepted. No unreviewed model answer is ground truth.

future_training_hypotheses.treatment: Add a separately versioned eligible original-source/context corpus with explicit labels; preserve B and compare a new adapter.
future_training_hypotheses.constraint: No unlabeled merging of competing readings or private/unapproved source material; training and released weights need their own use decision.

evaluation_separation.comparison: Unchanged A and retained B with identical evidence access, then any separately authorized new adapter.
evaluation_separation.limitations: The40 proposed public cases are development material; neither they nor their selection establish a representative final benchmark.

limitations: Rights observations are narrow upstream statements, not a sweeping legal conclusion or settled training-weight opinion.

Unselected source versions and hashes remain null until exact artifacts are chosen. The implemented TVTMS reference component has an explicit version, raw hash and derived-map hash; this does not clear other components.
Some proposed textual cases are prominent disputes; nearby controls and a separate hidden test are required.
No specialist review, source acquisition, historical-accuracy improvement or future training result is claimed.

current_implementation.scope: English-standard to Hebrew-MT reference lookup into existing OSHB text. NT lookup remains SBLGNT-numbered. No new historical content, witness text or training data.
